resources.string: Architecture, technologies, compatibility and internal performance of MyNotes.
Technical information about the application and its internal operation.
The module is built with compileSdk 37, targetSdk 36 and minSdk 24. Release builds enable code minification and resource shrinking through the Android/ProGuard tooling configured by the project.
The interface is built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3. The app uses edge-to-edge immersive rendering and stays synchronized with VSYNC through the normal Compose/Choreographer pipeline.

The main Activity coordinates Compose navigation. ViewModels expose state and actions, repositories centralize persistence and data logic, Room manages notes and attachments, and DataStore stores configurable application preferences.

Notes are stored locally in Room. Attachments live in private app storage and thumbnails are cached to avoid decoding heavy files again while scrolling. Android may clear the cache when space is needed; the app rebuilds it from the original file.

Coil 3 handles images and remote resources, Media3/ExoPlayer plays video and audio, and AttachmentPreviewCache generates and reuses previews for images, video, album art and PDF first pages. Link previews are processed separately so they do not block the UI.
The option selected in Settings controls both the preferred display refresh rate and the resolution used by cached thumbnails.
60 Hz. Images and video up to 360 px, album art 256 px and PDF 480 px. Prioritizes lower CPU, memory and decoding load.
60 Hz. Images and video up to 720 px, album art 512 px and PDF 960 px. Balances sharpness and resource usage.
Up to 120 Hz when supported. Images up to 1280 px, video 1080 px, album art 768 px and PDF 1440 px. Prioritizes visual quality.

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Room 2.7.2 + KSP, DataStore Preferences 1.1.7, Coil 3.3.0, Media3/ExoPlayer 1.11.0, Lifecycle Runtime Compose 2.11.0, AppCompat 1.7.1 and Kotlin coroutines. The project uses Java 11 compatibility.

MyNotes is designed to run from Android 7.0/API 24 and adapts several performance decisions for older devices. Refresh-rate preferences are requests to the system: Android may choose another mode when the display or compositor cannot provide the exact requested rate.

The app declares Internet access for remote previews, audio recording for voice notes and vibration for haptic feedback. Microphone hardware is optional. FileProvider enables secure file sharing and ACTION_SEND lets MyNotes create notes from text shared by other applications.

MyNotes is a project developed and directed by Snow. OpenAI ChatGPT is credited as technical assistance used for review, documentation and development support; it does not replace the project’s primary authorship.
